name: College of Swords
label: Bard College
summary: Blade-dancing entertainers who spend inspiration dice on damaging combat flourishes.
flavor: Bards of the College of Swords are called blades, and they entertain through daring feats of weapon prowess — sword-swallowing, knife-throwing, mock combats. Many use their showmanship as a cover for far more dangerous work.
playstyle: The damage-dealing bard. Blade Flourish adds movement and turns Bardic Inspiration dice into extra damage plus a rider effect, so your dice fuel your own offense rather than allies' rolls.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar. If you're proficient with a simple or martial melee weapon, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose Dueling (+2 damage with a single one-handed melee weapon) or Two-Weapon Fighting (add your ability modifier to the off-hand attack's damage).

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description:
Whenever you take the Attack action, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the turn. If you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration for one of these flourishes (the die is added to the attack's damage roll in each case):

**Defensive Flourish.** You add the die to your AC until the start of your next turn.

**Slashing Flourish.** You also deal damage equal to the die to one other creature of your choice within 5 feet.

**Mobile Flourish.** You push the target up to 5 feet plus the number rolled, and can then use your reaction to move up to your walking speed to a space within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.description: Whenever you use a Blade Flourish option, you can roll a d6 and use it instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.
